reason: On my student budget, 69,000 VND ($2.67) for seven days is tough to justify when free ChatGPT, NotebookLM, and our campus Drive exam banks already cost $0. Passing by in a normal week, I'd at most bookmark the free starter deck for exam week instead of scanning VietQR today.
objection: I'm skeptical it will cleanly handle 150+ mixed English-Vietnamese quantitative slides and match what my lecturers actually test, and if it misses the mark 48 hours before a midterm, a full refund won't give me those wasted hours back.
would_change_my_mind: Pricing the 7-day pass around 20,000–25,000 VND (~$0.80–$1.00)—about the cost of one campus coffee or printing my slides—so it feels like an easy impulse add-on during exam week.
